properties.name: houtu.id.work-id.type
properties.description: WorkerIdProvider backend type. Defaults to redis; explicitly set to db to switch backend.

properties.name: houtu.id.work-id.worker-bits
properties.description: Bit width of workerId; pool capacity is (1 << workerBits). Default 5, aligned with SnowflakeOptions.DEFAULT_WORKER_BITS.

values.description: Use Redis as the WorkerId allocation backend (RedisWorkerIdProvider). Requires a StringRedisTemplate bean on the classpath.
Use a relational database as the WorkerId allocation backend (DbWorkerIdProvider). Requires a JdbcTemplate bean and the snowflake_worker table (see workid/db/example-ddl.sql).
